imagePaths.description: Source images to compose, in scene order (2+ of .png, .jpg, .jpeg, .webp, .bmp).

captions.description: One caption per image, aligned to imagePaths order.

sceneDurationSeconds.description: How long each scene is shown, in seconds. Defaults to 4.

outputPath.description: Where to write the composed .mp4 (a sibling .srt is written alongside it). Must not already exist.

aspectRatio.description: Video frame shape. 16:9 for landscape/desktop viewing (default), 9:16 for vertical short-form video.

titleImagePath.description: Optional. An image (a logo, a branded background, anything) shown as an opening title card with titleText burned in large and centered, before the first scene. Must be given together with titleText.

titleText.description: Text burned onto titleImagePath. Must be given together with titleImagePath.

outroImagePath.description: Optional. Same as titleImagePath but shown as a closing card after the last scene, with outroText. Must be given together with outroText.

outroText.description: Text burned onto outroImagePath. Must be given together with outroImagePath.
